selection.split: official test images reused for a post-hoc engineering repair repeat
selection.rule: Reuse every image from the declared previous cohort; no filtering by failure or accuracy
selection.primary_metric: all-attempt proportion within 10% of annotation-derived count; failures score zero
secondary_metrics: complete-cohort MAPE only if all answered
selection.answer_policy: Retain independently validated counts if downstream review fails, explicitly labelled unreviewed_after_error. Report full review completion separately; unreviewed output is not JEV approval.
selection.input_policy: same question and 1/99.8 percentile preview for both arms; tool arm also gets original uint16 file
selection.retry_policy: One configured transient API retry per request, one catalog semantic repair, one research token-limit retry; existing 48-call/1500-second/two-round limits. No whole-trial retries.
limitations: counting derived from segmentation labels, not original benchmark metric
12 images are a pilot, not a broad multimodal claim
CPU-only deployment and bounded catalog search
Previously inspected cohort: repair evidence, not fresh held-out generalization
Existing vanilla controls reused; no new vanilla inference
Coverage with unreviewed fallbacks is distinct from complete-harness review coverage
selection.runtime_condition: Local Docker CPU workers; cloud benchmark coordinator also active. Caffeinate does not prevent lid-close sleep. Runtime is observational, not a controlled speed comparison.
repairs: catalog IDs/source validation with one repair
verified installed StarDist loader and call contracts
executor reports execution rather than blocking on a second visual approval
validated artifact retention with explicit review status
